import pybamm


def model(name, with_input=False):
    m = pybamm.BaseModel(name)
    a,b = pybamm.Variable('a'), pybamm.Variable('b')
    rate = pybamm.InputParameter('rate') if with_input else pybamm.Scalar(1)
